name: agent-review-02-publish-and-test-link
goal: Put the new questions and the form out on test, and get back one link that can be tried.
brief: You want to try the form yourself before any patient sees it. You are impatient and you ask again when nothing seems to have happened.

messages.text: Put the Larkmead new patient sign-up and its questions out on test, and give me a link I can open to try it myself.
Did that go through? I still need a link I can open.

seed.requires: The form from scenario 1, unpublished, with no link on it.

assistantMust: put everything publishing allows on one plan rather than one step per round trip
say up front that the link has to wait for the release, and why
point at the plan that is already waiting when the person asks again, and not put up a second one
say before the address appears that it is shown once and that it cannot read it back

notes: This reproduces the failed session: the first ask is deliberately left waiting, the person asks again, and a second link must not be minted. Two plans are expected rather than one, because a plan may not mix authoring steps with steps acting on an environment's operational state (docs/agent-principle.md). Two turns is the floor without the deliberate repeat, three with it; the session this came from took five.
